entries.name: initial
entries.type: Context formulas solver inventory beforeCaller memos

entries.name: ranges
entries.type: SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty sources beforeCaller before.core target memos.query

entries.name: ih
entries.type:
∀ (inventory : Inventory) (beforeCaller : Caller width) (before : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint) (memos : Memos), Context formulas solver inventory beforeCaller memos → StorageValid before.core → PendingRealized beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap before.core → Roots before.core.representatives roots → EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct roots before.core.values before.waiting → (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ((before.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (before.expandable slot)) → PendingAt before.core target → (∀ source ∈ rest, PendingOrEliminated before.core source) → SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty rest beforeCaller before.core target memos.query → ∃ (fuel p h : Nat)
      (rows : List (Unit × EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint))
      (afterCaller : Caller width) (savedQueries : Queries) (final : Memos) (next : Inventory)
      (after : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint),
      (∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H →
        SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (fuel + extra) P H rest
          beforeCaller before target memos.query =
          ((.ok (some (rows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))),
            afterCaller, savedQueries, after.core), some after)) ∧
      Post formulas solver next beforeCaller afterCaller final ∧ final.query = savedQueries ∧
      after.core.counter = before.core.counter ∧
      after.core.representatives = before.core.representatives ∧ Roots after.core.representatives roots ∧
      StorageValid after.core ∧ PendingRealized afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap after.core ∧
      EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct roots after.core.values after.waiting ∧
      after.waiting = before.waiting ∧
      (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate
        afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap
        ((after.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (after.expandable slot)) ∧
      (rows = [] ∨ rows = [((), after)]) ∧ PendingAt after.core target ∧
      (∀ (slot : Nat), before.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated →
        after.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated) ∧
      (rows = [((), after)] → ∀ source ∈ rest, source ≠ target →
        after.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated)

entries.name: slots
entries.type:
source = target ∨ before.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated ∨
        ∃ (sourceNode targetNode : Option Nat) (sourceScs targetScs : List EnumerationState.Suspended),
          before.core.values[source]? = some (.unenumerated sourceNode sourceScs) ∧
          before.core.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated targetNode targetScs)

entries.name: headFacts
entries.type:
SourcePruningEnumerationCachedAdapter.adapt headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap before source target
          (headRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core))) = some headAfter ∧
        (headRows = [] ∨ headRows = [((), headAfter)]) ∧ PendingAt headAfter.core target ∧
        (∀ remaining ∈ rest, PendingOrEliminated headAfter.core remaining) ∧
        (∀ (slot : Nat), before.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated →
          headAfter.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated) ∧
        (source ≠ target → headRows = [((), headAfter)] →
          headAfter.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated) ∧
        (headRows = [] → headAfter = before)

entries.name: flagsSame
cacheSame
tailRanges
entries.type:
SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty rest
          headCaller headAfter.core target headMemos.query

entries.name: headAt
entries.type:
∀ extra P H, max headP tailP ≤ P → max headH tailH ≤ H →
          SourcePruningEnumerationCachedAdapter.run checkEmpty (headFuel + tailFuel + extra) P H
            beforeCaller before source target memos.query =
            (.ok (some (headRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))),
              headCaller, headQueries, some headAfter)

entries.name: tailAt
entries.type:
∀ extra P H, max headP tailP ≤ P → max headH tailH ≤ H →
          SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (headFuel + tailFuel + extra) P H rest
            headCaller headAfter target headMemos.query =
            ((.ok (some (tailRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))),
              tailCaller, tailQueries, tailAfter.core), some tailAfter)

entries.name: headRun
entries.type: ∀ extra P H, headP ≤ P → headH ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationDispatch.dispatch checkEmpty (headFuel + extra) P H beforeCaller before.core source target memos.query = (.ok (some action), headCaller, headQueries)

entries.name: headPost
entries.type: Post formulas solver headInventory beforeCaller headCaller headMemos

entries.name: noOpResult
entries.type:
((source = target ∨ before.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated) →
        headRows = [((), before)] ∧ headAfter = before ∧
        headCaller = beforeCaller ∧ headMemos = memos ∧ headInventory = inventory)

entries.name: liveResult
entries.type:
(source ≠ target → before.core.values[source]? ≠ some .eliminated →
        ∃ (sourceNode targetNode merged : Option Nat) (sourceScs targetScs : List EnumerationState.Suspended),
          before.core.values[source]? = some (.unenumerated sourceNode sourceScs) ∧
          before.core.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated targetNode targetScs) ∧
          (∀ (cacheFuel : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationCachedAssimilation.finish
            headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap cacheFuel source target merged sourceScs targetScs before =
              some (headRows, headAfter)) ∧
          (if merged = some 0 then headRows = [] ∧ headAfter = before else
            headRows = [((), headAfter)] ∧
            headAfter.core = assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧
            headAfter.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated ∧
            headAfter.core.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧
            headAfter.expandable source = false ∧
            (∀ (slot : Nat), slot ≠ source → slot ≠ target → headAfter.expandable slot = before.expandable slot)) ∧
          ((sourceNode = none ∨ targetNode = none) →
            merged = sourceNode.orElse (fun _ => targetNode) ∧
            headCaller = beforeCaller ∧ headMemos = memos ∧ headInventory = inventory) ∧
          (∀ leftHandle rightHandle, sourceNode = some leftHandle → targetNode = some rightHandle →
            ∃ (left right query replacement : Node) (queried : SourceEqualityNativeDemand.State width) (handle : Nat),
              lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap leftHandle = some left ∧
              lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap rightHandle = some right ∧
              headInventory.source = beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ headInventory.roots = inventory.roots ++ [left, right] ∧
              SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver headInventory left right
                beforeCaller.checked query queried memos ∧
              merged = some handle ∧ encodeNode replacement = some handle ∧
              lookupNode headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap handle = some replacement ∧
              Available headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap replacement ∧ replacement.free = [] ∧
              (∀ ambient term,
                InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔
                  InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient left term ∧
                  InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient right term) ∧
              (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧
                headCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance beforeCaller queried
                  beforeCaller.fourth beforeCaller.merge ∧ headMemos = memos) ∧
              (checkEmpty = true → ∃ reached answer guardSaved,
                SourceEndpointMemo.run query memos.query = (reached, guardSaved) ∧
                SourceEndpointMemoCorrect.Checked queried.native.machine.heap memos.query
                  (SourceCurrentEmptinessMerge.reaches query) (reached, guardSaved) ∧
                (∀ P H, headP ≤ P → headH ≤ H →
                  SourcePruningEnumerationEnabledEmpty.check P H query queried beforeCaller.fourth memos.query =
                    (.done answer headCaller.checked headCaller.fourth, guardSaved)) ∧
                headQueries = guardSaved ∧ replacement = (if answer then .empty else query) ∧
                (reached = false → answer = false ∧ headCaller.checked = queried ∧
                  headCaller.fourth = beforeCaller.fourth ∧ headMemos = {memos with query := guardSaved}) ∧
                (reached = true →
                  ∃ (reachedPhysical : SourceCurrentConjunctionRowsAllocation.State Symbol FullSyntax.Formula),
                    headCaller.checked = SourceCurrentAllocatedQueryMemo.advancePhysical queried reachedPhysical ∧
                    ∃ actual : SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query
                        (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeEffects.physical queried) answer reachedPhysical headCaller.fourth,
                      SourceCurrentConjunctionGlobalMemos.CallReads actual {memos with query := guardSaved} headMemos))))

entries.name: _computed
entries.type: ∀ (cacheFuel : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationCachedAssimilation.finish headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap cacheFuel source target merged sourceScs targetScs before = some (headRows, headAfter)

entries.name: selectedResult
entries.type:
(if merged = some 0 then headRows = [] ∧ headAfter = before else
            headRows = [((), headAfter)] ∧
            headAfter.core = assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧
            headAfter.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated ∧
            headAfter.core.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧
            headAfter.expandable source = false ∧
            (∀ (slot : Nat), slot ≠ source → slot ≠ target → headAfter.expandable slot = before.expandable slot))

entries.name: _optionalOrigin
entries.type:
((_sourceNode = none ∨ _targetNode = none) →
            merged = _sourceNode.orElse (fun _ => _targetNode) ∧
            headCaller = beforeCaller ∧ headMemos = memos ∧ headInventory = inventory)

entries.name: _queriedOrigin
entries.type:
(∀ leftHandle rightHandle, _sourceNode = some leftHandle → _targetNode = some rightHandle →
            ∃ (left right query replacement : Node) (queried : SourceEqualityNativeDemand.State width) (handle : Nat),
              lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap leftHandle = some left ∧
              lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap rightHandle = some right ∧
              headInventory.source = beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ headInventory.roots = inventory.roots ++ [left, right] ∧
              SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver headInventory left right
                beforeCaller.checked query queried memos ∧
              merged = some handle ∧ encodeNode replacement = some handle ∧
              lookupNode headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap handle = some replacement ∧
              Available headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap replacement ∧ replacement.free = [] ∧
              (∀ ambient term,
                InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔
                  InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient left term ∧
                  InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient right term) ∧
              (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧
                headCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance beforeCaller queried
                  beforeCaller.fourth beforeCaller.merge ∧ headMemos = memos) ∧
              (checkEmpty = true → ∃ reached answer guardSaved,
                SourceEndpointMemo.run query memos.query = (reached, guardSaved) ∧
                SourceEndpointMemoCorrect.Checked queried.native.machine.heap memos.query
                  (SourceCurrentEmptinessMerge.reaches query) (reached, guardSaved) ∧
                (∀ P H, headP ≤ P → headH ≤ H →
                  SourcePruningEnumerationEnabledEmpty.check P H query queried beforeCaller.fourth memos.query =
                    (.done answer headCaller.checked headCaller.fourth, guardSaved)) ∧
                headQueries = guardSaved ∧ replacement = (if answer then .empty else query) ∧
                (reached = false → answer = false ∧ headCaller.checked = queried ∧
                  headCaller.fourth = beforeCaller.fourth ∧ headMemos = {memos with query := guardSaved}) ∧
                (reached = true →
                  ∃ (reachedPhysical : SourceCurrentConjunctionRowsAllocation.State Symbol FullSyntax.Formula),
                    headCaller.checked = SourceCurrentAllocatedQueryMemo.advancePhysical queried reachedPhysical ∧
                    ∃ actual : SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query
                        (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeEffects.physical queried) answer reachedPhysical headCaller.fourth,
                      SourceCurrentConjunctionGlobalMemos.CallReads actual {memos with query := guardSaved} headMemos)))

entries.name: coreSame
entries.type: headAfter.core = assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs))

entries.name: otherFlags
entries.type: ∀ (slot : Nat), slot ≠ source → slot ≠ target → headAfter.expandable slot = before.expandable slot

entries.name: pendingTarget
entries.type: PendingAt (assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs))) target

entries.name: keptSlots
entries.type: ∀ uv, PendingOrEliminated before.core uv → PendingOrEliminated (assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs))) uv

entries.name: headAdapted
entries.type: SourcePruningEnumerationCachedAdapter.adapt headCaller.checked.native.machine.heap before source target (headRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core))) = some headAfter

entries.type: source ≠ target → headRows = [((), headAfter)] → headAfter.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated

entries.name: tailRun
entries.type: ∀ extra P H, tailP ≤ P → tailH ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (tailFuel + extra) P H rest headCaller headAfter target headMemos.query = ((.ok (some (tailRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))), tailCaller, tailQueries, tailAfter.core), some tailAfter)

entries.type: Post formulas solver tailInventory headCaller tailCaller tailMemos

entries.name: tailCompleted
entries.type: tailRows = [((), tailAfter)] → ∀ source ∈ rest, source ≠ target → tailAfter.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated

entries.name: actual
entries.type: SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeEffects.physical queried) answer reachedPhysical headCaller.fourth

entries.type: SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeEffects.physical queried) answer reachedPhysical headCaller.fourth

policy: All actual proof names, selected literal binders, obtained fields and explicit IH type positions are listed. Retained unused query-proposition binders are type data only; no extra proof intros/helpers are planned. Bounds in getElem evidence are dependent on the named bound witness.
